The '''Noonian sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that bordered [[Halthor sector/Legends|Halthor sector]].

==History==
The sector was governed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Trophan Thanis]].

[[Smuggler/Legends|Smugglers]] [[Thi Sawrtin]] and [[Zayl Braith]] performed "routine" smuggling runs through this [[Sector/Legends|sector]], until they were captured by Imperial [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor cruiser]] ''[[Tory's Catcher]]''. Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gresia Vleen]] then executed Sawrtin, impounded their ship and sent Braith to the prison of [[Rol Two]].<ref name="air">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
